issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to interact with external shortlink services and APIs, potentially transmitting user navigation data and page context.
issues.location: Multiple places in main script logic (bypass routines)
issues.recommendation: Restrict external requests to only necessary endpoints, avoid transmitting sensitive user data, and document all external destinations.

issues.description: Script reads and manipulates localStorage, sessionStorage, and may access cookies to manage bypass state and tokens.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only non-sensitive data is accessed and never transmitted externally.

issues.description: Script uses innerHTML and document.write to inject bypassed links and content, which may allow DOM XSS if user input or URL parameters are not sanitized.
issues.recommendation: Always sanitize user input and URL parameters before inserting into DOM.

issues.description: Script loads external code via @require from update.greasyfork.org, but does not use version hash or integrity checks.
issues.recommendation: Pin @require to a specific version hash and verify source integrity.

issues.description: Script requests high privileges (GM_openInTab, GM_setClipboard, GM_xmlhttpRequest) but may not use all safely or minimally.
issues.recommendation: Reduce privilege scope to only what is strictly necessary.

issues.description: Script uses GM_setClipboard to copy bypassed links, which could be abused if malicious links are injected.
issues.recommendation: Validate all links before copying to clipboard.

issues.description: Script uses innerHTML and document.write with dynamic content, increasing risk of injection.
issues.recommendation: Avoid using innerHTML/document.write with unsanitized data.

details: May access cookies for bypass tokens

summary: The script poses significant risks due to data transmission to third-party services, privacy collection, DOM XSS vulnerabilities, and supply chain risks. It requests high privileges and manipulates sensitive APIs. Use with caution and only after thorough review of all external endpoints and bypass logic.
